mechanism: Nalmefene is an opioid antagonist that may reduce the efficacy of concurrent medications through competitive antagonism and potential CYP3A4 interactions, while nifedipine is metabolized by CYP3A4, potentially increasing nifedipine levels.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely; nalmefene may unpredictably affect nifedipine efficacy; consider alternative antihypertensive agents if opioid antagonism is clinically necessary.
